cart_empty_body: Add products from the catalog, then send the order to your supplier.
price_rule: Prices come from your supplier's price list and are shown on the order once it is saved; they are fixed when the order is approved.
save_failed: The order could not be saved
errors.quantity_invalid: Enter a whole number between 1 and 1,000,000.
errors.meters_invalid: Enter meters above 0, at most two decimals.
errors.too_many: An order can have at most 200 products.
draft_kept: The draft was saved; sending again only retries the submission.
price_rule_center: An empty price uses the dealer's purchase price; a product without a price is added at 0 and flagged. The order starts approved, ready for the warehouse.
price_missing_body_one: {{count}} product had no price; it was added at 0 and flagged.
price_missing_body_other: {{count}} products had no price; they were added at 0 and flagged.
errors.price_invalid: Enter a price of 0 or more with up to 4 decimals.
confirm_no_price: Prices are not shown here: they are calculated when the order is saved and fixed on approval.
seller_warehouse_hint: The order goes to this warehouse; picking suggestions and warehouse notifications follow it.
timeline.title: Activity
self_prepare_hint: Warehouse staff are not notified; you prepare the order yourself.
warehouse_home.empty: No orders to prepare in this warehouse.
plotter.label: Sent plotter cut
plotter.failed: The plotter mark could not be saved
edit.title: Edit lines
edit.hint: Add products, change amounts or remove lines. A new line is priced from the price list. Removing a line with assigned barcodes frees them.
edit.failed: The lines could not be updated
edit.below_assigned: Cannot go below the assigned amount; unassign a barcode first.
edit.remove_assigned: {{name}} has assigned barcodes; they are released when you save.
recipient.title: New recipient
recipient.hint: A recipient without a dealer record goes to the waiting pool; you can open the order right away.
recipient.name: Name / company
recipient.errors.tax_no_invalid: Tax no has 10 digits, national ID 11.
quote.rate: Current rate: 1 {{currency}} = {{rate}} TRY. The rate is fixed when the order is approved.
quote.no_rate: No current rate; the TRY value cannot be shown.
quote.incomplete: Some products have no price or an invalid amount; the total is incomplete.
quote.pick_buyer: Pick the dealer first to see prices.
errors.discount_invalid: Discount must be between 0 and 100, with up to 2 decimals.
